sources.description: Feature PRD: Predictions, Scoring And Scoreboards
Approved feature plan with phased vertical slices
School JPA and MySQL guideline slides for repository/service boundaries and persisted prediction, member and team score updates.
School web-flow guideline slides for MVC form DTOs, @Valid handling and BindingResult flow in the prediction form.
School MVC and i18n guideline slides for resource-bundle validation messages and Thymeleaf form error rendering.
School security guideline slides for role-restricted MVC routes and authenticated-user behavior in prediction and scoreboard flows.
Exercise workspace for school-style JPA repository and service-layer patterns used by scoring persistence and recalculation.
Validation exercise workspace for DTO-backed Spring MVC forms and server-side form error handling.
Security exercise workspace for role-aware Spring MVC access patterns used by user-only prediction and scoreboard routes.

tasks.title: Prediction Input DTO With Validation
tasks.description: Create InputPredictionDTO in the dto package with two Integer fields: predictedScoreA and predictedScoreB. Annotate both with @NotNull and @Min(0) using Jakarta Validation. Add corresponding error messages to src/main/resources/i18n/messages.properties (e.g. prediction.scoreA.required, prediction.scoreA.min, prediction.scoreB.required, prediction.scoreB.min).
acceptance_criteria: InputPredictionDTO exists with predictedScoreA and predictedScoreB fields
Both fields annotated with @NotNull and @Min(0)
Resource bundle contains error messages for null and negative score validation failures

tasks.title: Prediction Repository User+Competition Query
tasks.description: Add a findByUserAndCompetition(MyUser user, Competition competition) method to PredictionRepository returning Optional<Prediction>. Add a unique constraint on (userId, competitionId) to the Prediction entity @Table annotation to enforce one prediction per user per match at the database level.
acceptance_criteria: PredictionRepository has findByUserAndCompetition returning Optional<Prediction>
Prediction entity has @Table uniqueConstraints on (userId, competitionId)
Application starts without errors with the new constraint

tasks.title: Prediction Service Create/Update
tasks.description: Create PredictionService in the service package. Implement a savePrediction(MyUser user, Competition competition, InputPredictionDTO dto) method that finds an existing prediction via the repository or creates a new one, sets the predicted scores from the DTO, sets createdAt on new predictions, and saves. Return the saved Prediction.
acceptance_criteria: PredictionService exists with savePrediction method
If no existing prediction, a new one is created and persisted
If an existing prediction exists, its scores are updated and persisted
createdAt is set on new predictions

tasks.title: Prediction Controller And Thymeleaf Form
tasks.description: Create PredictionController mapped to /predictions. GET /predictions/{competitionId} loads the competition, finds the user's existing prediction if any, pre-fills InputPredictionDTO, and renders a Thymeleaf form template (templates/prediction/form.html). POST /predictions/{competitionId} validates the DTO, calls PredictionService.savePrediction, and redirects on success or re-renders with errors. The route requires ROLE_USER in SecurityConfig. The form shows both country names and input fields for scores.
acceptance_criteria: GET /predictions/{competitionId} renders the prediction form for authenticated USER
Form displays country names for teamA and teamB
Form pre-fills existing prediction values when editing
POST validates DTO and shows errors on invalid input
POST saves prediction and redirects on success
Security config restricts /predictions/** to ROLE_USER
Guest is redirected to login, admin gets 403

tasks.title: One-Hour Cutoff Enforcement
tasks.description: In PredictionService.savePrediction, before saving, compute the cutoff as competition.date at competition.time minus 1 hour. If LocalDateTime.now() is at or after the cutoff, throw a custom exception or return an error. Add a resource bundle message (prediction.cutoff.passed). In PredictionController, catch the error and display it on the form. Optionally pass a cutoffPassed boolean to the template to disable the submit button.
acceptance_criteria: Service computes cutoff as competition date+time minus 1 hour
Service rejects prediction when current time >= cutoff
Error message prediction.cutoff.passed exists in resource bundle
Controller displays cutoff error message to the user
Form disables submit button when cutoff has passed

tasks.title: Scoring Constants In Resource Bundle
tasks.description: Add scoring constants to src/main/resources/i18n/messages.properties: scoring.exactScore=5, scoring.correctOutcome=2, scoring.uniqueExactBonus=3, scoring.uniqueOutcomeBonus=1. These will be read by ScoringService.
acceptance_criteria: messages.properties contains scoring.exactScore=5
messages.properties contains scoring.correctOutcome=2
messages.properties contains scoring.uniqueExactBonus=3
messages.properties contains scoring.uniqueOutcomeBonus=1

tasks.title: Scoring Service Implementation
tasks.description: Create ScoringService in the service package. Load scoring constants from the resource bundle (via @Value with property placeholders or MessageSource). Implement calculatePoints(Prediction prediction, Integer officialScoreA, Integer officialScoreB, List<Prediction> teamPredictions) that: awards exactScore points for exact match; awards correctOutcome points for correct winner/draw without exact match; awards 0 otherwise. Then compute unique bonuses: if only one prediction in teamPredictions has that exact score, add uniqueExactBonus; if only one has that outcome, add uniqueOutcomeBonus. Return total points.
acceptance_criteria: ScoringService exists and reads constants from resource bundle
Exact-score match awards 5 points
Correct outcome only awards 2 points
Wrong prediction awards 0 points
Unique exact-score bonus (+3) awarded when prediction is unique in team
Unique outcome bonus (+1) awarded when outcome is unique in team
Bonuses computed per team predictions list, not globally

tasks.title: Official Result Triggers Recalculation
tasks.description: When admin saves an official result (scoreA/scoreB) on a Competition via the existing CompetitionController/CompetitionService, trigger score recalculation. Add a method in ScoringService (or a new RecalculationService) that: finds all predictions for the competition, groups them by team (via each prediction user's team memberships), calculates points for each prediction using team context, updates prediction.pointsEarned, recalculates each affected TeamMember.score as sum of their prediction points, and recalculates each affected Team.score via calculateTeamScore(). Call this from the admin result-save flow.
acceptance_criteria: Admin saving official result triggers recalculation
All predictions for the competition are rescored
Each prediction.pointsEarned is updated and persisted
Each affected TeamMember.score is recalculated as sum of their prediction points
Each affected Team.score is recalculated from member scores
Changing an already-entered result recalculates correctly (idempotent)
Public ranking reflects updated team totals

tasks.title: Private Team Scoreboard
tasks.description: Add GET /team/{id}/scoreboard to TeamController (or a new ScoreboardController). Load the team and its members sorted by score descending. Verify the authenticated user is a member of the team; if not, throw AccessDeniedException (403). Render a Thymeleaf template (templates/team/scoreboard.html) showing member names, scores, and team total. Guests redirected to login. Admin gets 403.
acceptance_criteria: GET /team/{id}/scoreboard renders scoreboard for team members
Members listed sorted by score descending
Each row shows member name and score
Team total score displayed
Non-member authenticated user gets 403
Guest redirected to login
Admin gets 403

tasks.title: Prediction And Scoreboard Security Config
tasks.description: Ensure SecurityConfig explicitly restricts /predictions/** to ROLE_USER and /team/*/scoreboard to ROLE_USER. Admin (ROLE_ADMIN) should not have access to these routes. Membership check for scoreboard is enforced in the controller/service layer via AccessDeniedException, not only by URL pattern.
acceptance_criteria: Security config restricts /predictions/** to ROLE_USER
Security config restricts /team/*/scoreboard to ROLE_USER
Admin role gets 403 on prediction and scoreboard routes
Guest redirected to login on prediction and scoreboard routes
Scoreboard membership enforced server-side in controller/service

tasks.title: Scoring Service Unit Tests
tasks.description: Create ScoringServiceTests in the test package. Test cases: exact-score prediction earns 5; correct-outcome-only earns 2; wrong prediction earns 0; draw scenario works; unique exact bonus awards +3 when unique in team; unique outcome bonus awards +1 when unique; no bonus when multiple members share same prediction; cutoff rejection in PredictionService.
acceptance_criteria: Test: exact-score prediction earns 5 points
Test: correct-outcome-only earns 2 points
Test: wrong prediction earns 0 points
Test: draw scenario scored correctly
Test: unique exact bonus +3 when unique in team
Test: unique outcome bonus +1 when unique in team
Test: no bonus when multiple members share prediction
Test: cutoff enforcement rejects late predictions

tasks.title: Prediction MVC And Security Tests
tasks.description: Create PredictionMvcTests using MockMvc. Test GET and POST /predictions/{competitionId} for authenticated user with valid and invalid input. Security tests: guest cannot access prediction routes (redirect to login); admin gets 403; non-member cannot access scoreboard (403).
acceptance_criteria: MVC test: form submission succeeds for valid input
MVC test: form rejects invalid input with validation errors
Security test: guest cannot access prediction routes
Security test: admin cannot access prediction routes (403)
Security test: non-member cannot access scoreboard (403)

tasks.title: Prediction DTO Validation Tests
tasks.description: Create InputPredictionDTOValidationTests using Jakarta Validator. Test that null predictedScoreA/B fails validation. Test that negative values fail @Min(0). Test that valid non-negative integers pass.
acceptance_criteria: Test: null predictedScoreA fails validation
Test: null predictedScoreB fails validation
Test: negative predictedScoreA fails @Min(0)
Test: negative predictedScoreB fails @Min(0)
Test: valid non-negative values pass validation
